name: tr-tax-overview
description: Tax overview for Turkey (Türkiye) for tax year 2026: the starting point before any Turkish tax question. Covers the calendar tax year, the Turkish lira, the Revenue Administration (Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, GİB), residence and worldwide income for individuals and companies, the 2026 personal income tax tariff (15% to 40%, first band TRY 190,000, top band above TRY 5,300,000), corporate tax at 25% (30% for banks and other financial firms) with the 10% domestic minimum corporate tax, VAT at 20%, 10% and 1%, quarterly provisional tax, and the main filing dates for income tax, corporate tax, VAT and withholding returns, and the 20-year foreign income exemption for people settled from 2026. Trigger on: Turkey tax overview, Turkish tax system, taxes in Turkey, Türkiye vergi sistemi, how is Turkey taxed. Out of scope, see the domain skills: turkey-pit, tr-corporate-income-tax, turkey-vat, tr-payroll-social, tr-company-formation.
